localEvidenceRetentionFinding.title: Developer verification links are not reproducible from the stated workspace paths
facts: The current Developer report byte hash differs from the hash recorded in reviewer verdict 02.
The Developer report names test-results/gov04-retry-prior-final and test-results/gov04-retry-bound-final, but neither directory exists in the current workspace.
The immutable raw reports, marker, child evidence and frozen installer for the reviewed merge run were still available in isolated evidence storage and independently rehashed during this review.
localEvidenceRetentionFinding.requiredResolution: Regenerate the Developer verification report against the current bytes and preserve/export the verified evidence bundle to the configured retained evidence store before treating the Developer report as a durable audit index.

GitHub service evidence for the protected target ref, required GOV-04 checks/ruleset and active workflow/CODEOWNERS policy.
